description: This file is a PHP source code defining a Smarty plugin function 'cycle', which enables cycling through given values in Smarty templates. It contains the implementation of the 'smarty_function_cycle' function, handling parameters such as 'values', 'name', 'reset', 'print', 'advance', 'delimiter', and 'assign' to control the cycling behavior.

methods.name: smarty_function_cycle
methods.description: Main function implementing the cycle logic for Smarty templates. Handles cycling through values, resetting, and assigning variables based on input parameters.
